title: Rated consistently exceeds for initiatives beyond the project
summary: My second review moved up to consistently exceeds expectations. It credited initiatives I took inside the product team and across the company, and asked for my active help with the team on the quality of what we shipped.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: this is a performance review.
